label: remount of the customer's own stone
construction: A remount: the customer's existing center stone (shape and size as specified) set into a new ring of the specified style; one continuous shank; the stone seated in a new prong or bezel setting joined to the shank; the stone is the only stone unless accents are specified.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the ring fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
views: three-quarter view showing the stone in its new setting and the shank
top-down view of the stone shape and setting

checks.question: Does the center stone have the shape specified (round, oval, cushion, emerald cut, pear, marquise)?
Is the stone held by prongs or a bezel joined to the shank?
Is the shank one continuous band?
Is this a clean product photograph with a plain background and no extra objects or text?
